settings.description: This program is open to early founders, including people still at idea stage.

settings.label: LinkedIn, portfolio, GitHub, or public profile
Are you applying as a solo founder or as a team?

Business Basics
settings.description: Lightweight business, finance, and legal checks for early founders.
